Sara Collins: FYI BlueWave (AWS Marketplace reseller) raised a chargeback: AWS applied EU VAT to a US buyer on our March invoice and partner says they were charged tax which they didn't expect. they want reversal + explanation.
Tom Nguyen: do we have the marketplace invoice id + line items?
Sara Collins: invoice INV-AWS-2026-03-7701, line items in s3://redwood-prod/finance/marketplace/bluewave/INV-AWS-2026-03-7701-lines.csv
AWS-Partner-Bot: Notification: Order 2026-03-30-441 included tax_code=EU_VAT and buyer_country=US; tax_override flag present.
Priya Singh: ledger check: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, line_id, net_amount, tax_amount, buyer_country
FROM marketplace_invoices_lines
WHERE invoice_id='INV-AWS-2026-03-7701';
-- shows tax_amount $1,200 applied on lines for buyer_country='US'```
Diego Morales: interesting. could be mapping issue where buyer_country null defaulted to EU region. also check our tax classification mapping for AWS connector.
FinanceBot: Automated tax rule TR-21 flagged inconsistent buyer_country vs tax_code on 2026-03-30. Case RB-9801 opened.
Tom Nguyen: action items: 1) contact AWS support to request tax override reversal (case AWS-55231) 2) if AWS won't reverse, prepare credit memo to partner for taxes we incorrectly passed through 3) fix mapping in connector to use billing_address.country when present.
Sara Collins: I've opened AWS case AWS-55231 and attached buyer invoice + marketplace line csv. partner wants expedited reversal.
Priya Singh: accounting: if AWS issues reversal, we need to reverse recognition for Q1 tax lines. if not, we'll issue CM-TAX-2026-BW-01 for $1,200. can we get VP signoff on partner-credit for tax errors?
Diego Morales: I'll open INFRA-3205: "aws-connector: prefer buyer_address.country over inferred region when computing tax_code" and add replay job for affected invoices. linking RB-9801.
FinanceBot: AWS responded: preliminary - they can adjust tax on their settlement if buyer provides VAT exemption docs or if it's their error. AWS requests buyer confirmation; ETA 3 biz days.
Sara Collins: sent partner note asking them to confirm buyer country and provide any exemption docs. partner replied they will get buyer confirmation within 48h.
Tom Nguyen: if AWS can't correct, proceed with credit memo and deduct from partner reserve; finance to document tax exposure in monthly notes.
Priya Singh: noted 1) awaiting AWS reply 2) await buyer confirmation 3) prepare CM template. tagging @acct-pay for expedited route if needed.
FinanceBot: RB-9801 status 'waiting_on_partner_and_marketplace'. reminder set for 2026-04-15 to escalate if unresolved.
Sara Collins: thanks all, i'll update here when partner or AWS confirms.
